title: Negotiated Supplier Discounts Held by Each Corporate Travel Programme
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes holds a negotiated discount on published air fares, on published hotel rates and on published car rental rates, and each tier either does or does not reach the agency's preferred supplier rates and permit travellers to pool their personal Wanderlane Traveller Club points into a company pool.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Negotiated discount on published air fares | 0 per cent | 2 per cent | 4 per cent | 7 per cent | 10 per cent | 14 per cent |
| Negotiated discount on published hotel rates | 0 per cent | 3 per cent | 5 per cent | 8 per cent | 11 per cent | 15 per cent |
| Negotiated discount on published car rental rates | 0 per cent | 3 per cent | 6 per cent | 9 per cent | 12 per cent | 16 per cent |
| Reaches the agency's preferred supplier rates | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Travellers may pool personal club points into a company pool | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The Business Starter Programme holds no negotiated discount on any of the three products, all three figures standing at 0 per cent.
2. The air discount runs 0, 2, 4, 7, 10 and 14 per cent across the six tiers; the hotel discount runs 0, 3, 5, 8, 11 and 15 per cent; the car rental discount runs 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 and 16 per cent. The three are published separately and are not interchangeable between products.
3. Preferred supplier rates are held by the Business Pro Programme and every tier above it, and are not held by the Business Starter Programme or the Business Team Programme.
4. Pooling of personal Wanderlane Traveller Club points into a company pool is held by the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme, and by no tier below them.
